description: WASL Mobility Modaraba, formerly First Prudential Modaraba, was floated in December 1989 as a perpetual, multipurpose Modaraba. Through successive amalgamations and acquisitions it came under the management of WASL Investment Finance Limited, which acquired its management company, since renamed WASL Modaraba Management Company. It is engaged in Shariah-compliant leasing of two- and three-wheelers — both combustion and electric variants — offering non-collateralised Ijarah rentals and Musharakah financing, working with gig-economy platforms as well as retail customers, and runs a pilot electric-rickshaw fleet.
